result:
Round 308 passes: all 10 acceptance rows pass, I found no bugs, and the six browser rows were run for real. So `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true.

**What I checked in the browser** (Playwright with Chromium, on a production build of A's code served at :5190, plus the dev server at :5173):
- **CONT-1 and CONT-30 (no audible break during an edit while playing):** 12 valid runs (6 per row, 1440×900 and 1280×720), none discarded. Editing a fade restarts 1 sound source with one clip and 30 with 30 clips. The biggest sample jump at the edit point was 0.0013–0.0015, below the normal level in the second before (0.0035). There was no silence gap. So there is no click, and PERF-COMMIT-RESCHEDULE can close on this evidence as B planned.
- **ENDED:** Chromium behaves as B measured. A sound stopped before it starts still reports "ended" at 0.311 s, a later second stop wins (0.908 s), and nothing throws.
- **NO-CHANGE:** at both window sizes, all 12 edits with 30 clips restarted 30 sources, playback kept running and the position kept moving. There were no long frames, and the slowest input event took 32 ms.
- **PLAY-SMOKE-308:** I added the Bass stem, played it and dragged its fade-in while it played. The edit took effect and playback continued. The exported WAV is valid: 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo, exactly 16.000 s, peak 0.217, no corrupt samples, and the fade-in shows in the audio levels.
- **G308-AUTH (no premium bypass):** in a fresh window with no login, the demo `/studio-lab` works. The purchased `/studio/middle-east` page shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. The Studio token endpoint returns 401 without a login, and no token appears in any response.

**Offline checks:**
- **Scope:** A changed exactly the 3 allowed files and nothing else.
- **Claims:** my run of the claims script matched A's output exactly.
- **Tests:** I re-ran the 12 related test files (211 tests, all green). The two new tests (RC12, RC13) match the task, and A's three mutants made them fail as listed.
- **Implementation doc:** correct status line and all required sections.

Full test suite, build, lint, `verify` and the e2e smoke are left to the root gate.

**Three notes for B (info only):**
- **Repeated test conditions:** several runs repeated the same edit position, so the 6 runs per row cover only 2–4 distinct positions. The probe doesn't save raw audio, so I can't fully rule out a stale capture after the fact. Any future probe of this kind should vary the edit time and save the captures.
- **Can the probe catch a click?** I tried a check of my own: a hard Stop during playback, to see whether the click test flags a real break. It was inconclusive, because Stop cuts the audio tap and nothing is recorded after the cut. So the "no click" result rests on B's click rule. It has not been proven to catch a real break.
- **Slow first loads:** two pages timed out on their first, uncompiled load before any measurement. I loaded each page once and re-ran, and the runs were then valid.

Video playback was not in this round's scope, so I didn't test it. I changed no app code.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-308.md
- c-round-308.json
- c-round-308/
